environment.description: Migration script runs in an EKS pod within a Fargate profile ('migration-jobs' namespace). The pod's IAM role (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/MigrationTaskRole) has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/HSMOnlyBoundary) that restricts all network egress except to the CloudHSM cluster ENI on port 2223. A Cilium L7 network policy (CiliumNetworkPolicy resource 'ldap-filter-policy') is applied that performs protocol-aware LDAP inspection: it parses LDAP search filter ASTs and rejects any filter containing wildcard assertions in non-indexed attributes, OR-clauses exceeding depth 2, or any attribute assertion where the attribute value contains unescaped RFC 4515 special characters (parentheses, asterisks, backslashes, NUL). The Cilium policy operates at the pod network namespace level via eBPF and cannot be bypassed from within the container. Additionally, the LDAP server is AWS Directory Service for Microsoft AD (managed) which independently enforces a 50-character maximum on individual filter assertion values and rejects filters with more than 3 clauses at any nesting level.

rules: reject filter assertion values containing unescaped ( ) * \ NUL per RFC 4515
reject wildcard assertions on non-indexed attributes

config.ldap_server: AWS Directory Service Managed Microsoft AD
config.egress_restriction: CloudHSM ENI port 2223 and managed AD ENI port 636 only
